policy.rule: No candidate is production-approved from desktop evidence alone. Any future ALLOW requires clean security/license gates, measured full memory/cancellation behavior, and genuine iOS Safari + Android Chrome receipts when the operation is in the heavy mobile scope.
policy.physicalEvidenceRule: Desktop browsers, Playwright WebKit, device descriptors and viewport emulation are not physical-device evidence.

familyRecommendations.recommendedStack: Feature-detect native image decode first; libheif-js 1.23.5 as a lazy worker-owned fallback candidate only after mobile memory/license-packaging acceptance.
familyRecommendations.refusalFallback: If native decode is absent and the libheif worker exceeds capability/resource gates, return an explicit unsupported/limit state. Do not upload the image.

familyRecommendations.recommendedStack: Tesseract.js 7.0.0 with same-origin tesseract.js-core and @tesseract.js-data/ita assets, isolated in a terminable worker.
familyRecommendations.refusalFallback: Refuse OCR when worker/WASM/capability or file-size/pixel preflight fails. Searchable-PDF composition remains a separate PDF/OCR integration ticket.

familyRecommendations.recommendedStack: Mammoth for semantic DOCX extraction, docx for bounded generation, docx-preview only as a non-fidelity preview experiment. No XLSX/PPTX production library is approved by this refresh.
familyRecommendations.refusalFallback: Deny xlsx 0.18.5 and pptxgenjs 4.0.1 on current audit evidence. Refuse claims of faithful Office rendering/conversion until ticket 270 supplies a clean audited stack and fidelity corpus.

familyRecommendations.recommendedStack: Keep existing in-house PDF operations in production; evaluate @cantoo/pdf-lib 2.11.1 for mutation and pdfjs-dist 6.4.299 for lazy render/text behind worker/corpus limits.
familyRecommendations.refusalFallback: Do not expose advanced editing/render claims where hostile/corrupt corpus, cancellation or mobile memory gates are still open.

familyRecommendations.recommendedStack: Web Audio for bounded DSP and Mediabunny/WebCodecs for supported local containers/codecs. Treat actual encode/decode support as a runtime capability, not a browser-name assumption.
familyRecommendations.refusalFallback: Deny lamejs as the new baseline and refuse formats/codecs unsupported by the local capability matrix; no server transcoding fallback.

familyRecommendations.recommendedStack: Mediabunny 1.61.3 is the primary inspection/container candidate; mp4box 2.4.1 remains a smaller MP4-specific alternate. Transcoding must stay WebCodecs/capability-gated.
familyRecommendations.refusalFallback: Deny the current ffmpeg.wasm production path because its official core is GPL under the repository's dependency policy. Refuse unsupported transcodes locally instead of silently uploading media.
